Add missing provider information for [REDACTED] and specific details of the Diazepam taper script omitted from the February 16, 2026, discharge paperwork.

Reason for Request:

The diagnosis of 'opiate use' is contradicted by the treatment provided during the same visit (10mg Diazepam).
